summary: Add category management to the app: allow users to edit (name only) and delete categories shown below the Favorites tab; deleting a category should detach items rather than delete them.
architectural_notes: Category delete must detach associated items (no cascading deletes).
Category edit supports renaming only; other item fields remain editable elsewhere.

existing_features.title: Provide a way to edit (rename) and delete categories directly from the category list displayed below the "Favorites" control (the category badges area in the filter bar).

Limit category editing to name-only changes, and persist category renames end-to-end: update the categories list and update any prompts currently using the category so they reference the new category name.

When deleting a category, detach it from prompts (remove that category from each prompt’s categories array) and keep the prompts themselves; then remove the category from the categories list and backend storage.

new_feature_requests.summary: Enable editing (name only) and deleting categories shown below the Favorites tab; deleting a category detaches items and keeps them.
